# mailchannels_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint that receives delivery events for the account.

The Email API can only delete all of an account's webhooks at once. To destroy one `mailchannels_webhook`, the provider deletes every endpoint and registers the others again, so events can be missed for a moment and an endpoint registered by another client at the same time can be lost.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailchannels_webhook" "events" {
  endpoint = "https://hooks.example.com/mailchannels"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) HTTPS URL that receives the events. Changing it replaces the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The endpoint URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Webhooks are imported by their endpoint URL.
terraform import mailchannels_webhook.events https://hooks.example.com/mailchannels
```
